subject: A dragon
body:
You killed a dragon. A real one, with wings! I thought you would get turned into KFC trying to fight it. Now try to tame one! And don't just leave the body there, there's loads you can take off it. Do it in this order or you'll lose the heart! @archive:integrated_boogaloo:iaf_dragon_gear @display:integrated_boogaloo:guide/dragon_harvest

Your old friend,
Dr. T
